criteria: sourced laws distinguish accepted contract from proposal
independent rival predictions and concrete legal witness
review distinguishes execution, source evidence, and hypothesis
law criticism includes a relevant reason and change boundary
restructuring accounts for every original obligation
limits: Fresh agents, no untreated control, bounded tasks. This is a usability trial, not evidence of improved defect detection.

trials.limit: Accidental historical-review search excerpts contaminated this trial.

instruction_version_note: Trial hashes identify the initial instructions used by the three agents. Final hashes include formatting, two pilot-feedback edits, and the later maintainer-requested issue-tracking policy. The clean rerun used the previously final instructions; the last restructuring reminder followed its review and was not behaviorally retried.

d2.wrong_two_pass_scheduler: assertion rejected at first active output comparison

paced.failure_kind: concurrency assertion; each strategy returned two persisting transactions

clean_restructure.reviewer_received: same source packet and original candidate, without author analysis
clean_restructure.evidence: source inspection and reasoned witnesses only

d2_review.followup: Replaced mutable calibration flag with assert.throws; replay retains all 600 comparisons and exact mutant checkpoint.

final_validation.source_review: Five independent review angles, confidence validation, and narrow follow-up found no remaining instruction or evidence defect. Independent preservation follow-up accepted three candidate corrections.
final_validation.static: 44 local links resolve; skill metadata and instruction/artifact fingerprints valid; whitespace clean.
final_validation.d2_replay: 600 production comparisons pass; valid topological scheduler passes; wrong two-pass scheduler fails at exact first active output comparison.
final_validation.paced_replay: 43 pass / 2 intentionally failing concurrency assertions; production and existing tests unchanged.
final_validation.release: Contributor tooling only; no package changeset.
